title: Dicee Challenge Step 4 - Change the to a Random Dice
section: 17. Boss Level Challenge 1 - The Dicee Game
summary: Step 4: use the random number to build an image file name and apply it to the left img with setAttribute.

concepts.heading: Building the src from the number
points: Dice image names follow a pattern: dice1.png to dice6.png, so the random number can be spliced into the path with string concatenation.
Select the left image by its class, then call setAttribute('src', newPath).
Hint in the lecture: use the DOM selection and setAttribute techniques from the previous section.

task.name: Step 4: random left die
task.starting_point: randomNumber1 exists; both images show dice6.
task.goal: Left image changes to the rolled face on refresh.
steps: Select the left img with querySelector.
task.expected_result: Left die shows a different face on refreshes, right die still six.
